insight: Both Isaiah 40:31 and Lamentations 3:25-26 emphasize the active, expectant waiting upon the LORD, using the Hebrew verb qavah to convey hopeful trust rather than passive delay. Isaiah highlights the transformative strength granted to those who habitually wait on God, enabling them to rise above weariness, while Lamentations affirms that God's goodness is revealed to those who patiently wait and diligently seek Him. Together, these passages underscore that faithful waiting and seeking are dynamic, covenantal responses that lead to experiencing God's sustaining power and benevolence.
